d: We are seeking a results-driven and dynamic Air Freight Sales Executive to join our commercial team in Jeddah 🚀

In this role, you will be responsible for driving business growth by acquiring new corporate clients, expanding air cargo volumes, and delivering tailored international air freight solutions that meet the time-sensitive needs of our customers across the Western Region.
q: 2–4 years of proven B2B sales experience in Air Freight, Freight Forwarding, or Logistics within Saudi Arabia.
Strong understanding of air cargo operations, Incoterms, IATA regulations, and customs clearance procedures.
Established network of corporate clients and importers/exporters in the Western Region (Jeddah) is a strong advantage.
Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Fluency in both Arabic and English, with strong CRM and reporting capabilities.
Valid Saudi driver’s license and willingness to conduct regular client field visits.
r: Identify, prospect, and onboard new B2B clients requiring international and domestic air freight services (import/export).
Develop competitive air freight quotations and commercial proposals in coordination with the pricing and operations teams.
Manage and grow an existing portfolio of corporate accounts, ensuring high customer satisfaction and repeat business.
Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue and tonnage targets.
Negotiate service agreements, rates, and transit schedules with clients while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Monitor market trends, airline capacities, and competitor activities in the Saudi air cargo sector to identify new business opportunities.
Collaborate closely with air operations and customs clearance teams to ensure smooth, on-time shipment execution.
